description: This visual is not certified by Microsoft Power BI team. If you want the certified version of this visual, please check SPC Attribute Chart (Pro). Please note all our Pro visuals can be exported to PPT/PDF. All of our visuals, including those not certified by Microsoft, do not access any external services or resources and this can be verified with browser (Edge, Chrome, Firefox) developer tools. Description Using PBIVizEdit SPC Attribute Chart (Standard) you can create: p chart for proportion of defects. np chart for number of defects. c chart for defect count per item. u chart for defects per unit. Laney p’/u’ charts for over dispersed data. G chart for units between rare events. T chart for time between rare events. Features available Laney charts for handling overdispersion. Detect patterns like ascending, descending, above/below mean, zigzag, and run length violations. Custom upper- and lower-line data type and aggregation like mean, median, standard deviation etc. Show standard deviation lines as reference points for variation. Custom axis and label formatting and marker styles. Customizable control limits and center lines.
